description: This file defines extension methods for working with sets and dictionaries in C#. It provides utility functions such as converting an IEnumerable to a HashSet, converting an IEnumerable to a string representation, and retrieving or adding a new value in a dictionary.

classes.name: SetExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for set and dictionary operations.

methods.name: ToSet
methods.description: Creates a HashSet from an IEnumerable with type inference.

methods.name: ToStrings
methods.description: Converts an IEnumerable to a space-separated string of its elements, with optional custom conversion and separator.

methods.name: GetValueOrAddNew
methods.description: Retrieves a value from a dictionary by key or adds a new default entry if the key doesn't exist.
